senses.gloss: phuluphulu (or ˚la, or huluhulu), onomat., a sound made by Māraʼs hosts: LV 〔306.3〕. See prec.

phulla, adj. (like Skt. id. from Skt. phalati, bursts; but not in this sense in Skt.; = Pali id.), broken: khaṇḍaphu˚ (= Pali id.) Mvy 〔9427〕; replaced by (khaṇḍa-)sphuṭa (see sphuṭa 2) in Divy 〔22.11, 18〕; 〔23.1, 3, 8〕, or sphuṭita, 10.
phullita, adj. (= Pali id.; denom. pple. to Skt. phulla, cf. rare Skt. phullati), in full bloom: Mvy 〔6233〕 (˚tam); Mv 〔ii.449.2, 3〕 (of lotuses); ˚ta-pādapake LV 〔321.20〕 (vs).
phullitaka, adj., = prec.: Mv 〔ii.449.4, 16〕 (of lotuses; prose).
